To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the implementation of health insurance in the country will allow to ensure fair access to medical services, to improve the quality and availability of medical services, to ensure the sustainability of medical institutions.
health insurance is the most effective method of social protection for the population, and the type of health care insurance in Ukraine should be compulsory state social medical.

medical insurance is a form of social protection of population, the implementation of which in Ukraine will allow to ensure fair access of citizens to medical services, to provide the state with the possibility to control the quality of medical services, to reduce the costs of medical care and to improve the quality of medical treatment of citizens in Ukraine.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the need for a comprehensive study of medical services market, the need to develop a system of medical insurance as a method of social protection in Ukraine.
the choice of the method of health protection of citizens in the conditions of market economy in the context of the social policy of Ukraine, which is the basis of the social protection of citizens.
the choice of the method of medical insurance in the context of the current socio economic conditions and constitutional restrictions in Ukraine.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the type of health care insurance as a method of social protection should be implemented in Ukraine in the form of a compulsory state social medical health insurance.
the health insurance in the state social medical insurance system is a method of social protection for the population, which is the most acceptable for Ukraine.
the type of health care insurance is a social and legal guarantee of the right of citizens to medical care.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

health insurance is the most appropriate method of social protection in Ukraine, because the access of the citizens of our country to medical care should be the key condition for the implementation of this type of social insurance.

the implementation of the compulsory state social insurance in Ukraine will contribute to the formation of a new system of medical services, where the main goal of medical insurance is to ensure the population with the right to receive medical care of the necessary quality, and to provide the medical service providers with the right to obtain a fair remuneration for their work.
the implementation of health insurance as the method for social protection of citizens will be a guarantee of fair access to quality medical care.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the type of medical services should be determined on the basis of their quality and not on the basis of price criteria, which is possible in the conditions of compulsory health insurance.
health insurance as a method of social protection is an important factor in the development of a competitive environment at the medical market.

the implementation of the system of state social medical insurance will allow the state to ensure the access of the whole population to the necessary medical services, which will be provided by the state in the form of social guarantees.
